decisions.decision: Six RNA-interference conditions each have six unique sources; four assay rows per source are technical sequencing records. Two TBX2 shRNAs share MYCN as partner and represent one canonical gene pair. Sequential TBX2 transduction and doxycycline-induced MYCN depletion have different initiation times. No explicit matched independent-initiation block map appears in SDRF; source numbering is not accepted as such a map. This is a useful replicated single-pair lead, not a broad held-pair confirmation bank.

Four-arm THZ1 35 nM/JQ1 1 uM comparison at 10 hours with four reported biological repeats. Four assay rows per source do not increase biological replication; one canonical pair and four repeats fail the original bank requirements.
